# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One, $99.99 ($80 with a code)**
- Best Products ranks it best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, and a good companion app with EQ ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Dealectric lists up to 98% noise reduction, 40 hours of battery with ANC on (55 with it off), Bluetooth 5.3 multipoint, and LDAC on Android ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100-2026-reviews-prices)).
- Code AFSC20 reportedly brings it to $80. Dealectric says it tested the code on 2026-10-22 and that it expires 2026-12-31. It doesn't work on items already on sale, so check your cart total.
- Downsides: it's a bit heavy (265 g), has no sweat resistance, and LDAC doesn't work while two devices are connected.
- **Buy:** [Soundcore Space One](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy, at no cost to you.

**Runner-up: Soundcore Space Q45, about $99**
- RTINGS names it the best budget noise-cancelling headphone it has tested, with very good engine-rumble isolation at around $100 ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- CartIQ lists 50 hours of battery (38 with ANC on), LDAC, and multipoint, but notes a creaky plastic headband ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Both RTINGS and CartIQ link to Amazon for it, but I only have their review pages, not a direct product link.

**Other options**
- **Sony WH-CH720N, about $99:** The lightest at 192 g, with 35 hours of battery. CartIQ rates it highly ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **JBL Tune 760NC, about $79:** A bass-forward pick with 35 hours of battery (same CartIQ page).
- **Edifier W820NB Plus, about $79:** 49 hours of battery and LDAC (same CartIQ page).
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, about $65:** The cheapest of these, with 70 hours of battery (same CartIQ page).
- **Raycon The Everyday Headphones, $80 on sale:** Best Products picks it for working out ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).

**Caveats**
- Prices change often, so confirm the current price at checkout.
- Budget ANC is generally a bit weaker than flagship ANC, especially on low-frequency rumble, and build quality is often more plastic ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- The CartIQ page is internally inconsistent. It labels the Sony as its top pick but the text praises the Q45, so I'd weigh RTINGS and Best Products more heavily.

If you tell me whether this is mainly for travel, the office, or workouts, I can narrow it to one.
